description: Writes short messages a business owner can text or email to a customer to ask for a Google review, adapted to the type of business. Use it when someone wants more Google reviews or asks how to ask a customer for a review. Returns up to three ready-to-send options with the owner's review link at the end. It does not send anything. The messages never offer incentives, which Google prohibits.

business_name.description: Name of the business asking for the review.

business_type.description: What kind of business it is, e.g. "plumber", "hair salon", "restaurant". Picks the right wording.

channel.description: text (SMS or WhatsApp) or email. Defaults to text.

customer_first_name.description: The customer's first name, if the owner gave it.

review_link.description: The business's Google review link if the owner has it (https://...). Leave out and the messages use a placeholder.

name: write_review_request_message
title: Write a review request message
